day4_night_start.name: {name}
day4_night_start.text: *I'm back home. Lying in my room, today's memories flicker past like a film reel.*

wall_seo_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_1.text: *10 PM. A call from Seoyeon. There's no laughter in her voice.*

wall_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_2.text: Can you come out right now? The park. — Sorry, it's sudden.

wall_seo_3.name: {name}
wall_seo_3.text: *Seoyeon is sitting on a park bench. Her eyes are red.*

wall_seo_6.name: {name}
wall_seo_6.text: *I sit beside her. Seoyeon is staring straight ahead. For a long time.*

wall_seo_9.name: {name}
wall_seo_9.text: *Seoyeon smiles. — It's not her usual composed smile. It's a smile for self-defense.*

wall_seo_10.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_10.text: Our house looks fine from the outside, right? Big house, nice car, student council president daughter. But Mom and Dad have been strangers under the same roof for a year. They just haven't filed the divorce papers.

wall_seo_11.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_11.text: Mom told me, 'At least you have to be perfect to hold this family together.'

wall_seo_12.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_12.text: I was ten. — She said that to a ten-year-old.

wall_seo_13.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_13.text: That's when I started practicing smiling in the mirror. The angle to lift my lips, the timing to crinkle my eyes.

wall_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_14.text: Every time I got praised, I thought, 'This smile was practiced too — has anyone ever seen the real me?'

wall_seo_15.name: {name}
wall_seo_15.text:
*Seoyeon stops talking. Her hands are clenched tight on her knees.*

*-- Then slowly, very slowly, the expression she'd been perfectly maintaining crumbles. Seoyeon takes off her glasses with trembling hands.*

*Tears flow from her eyes. Silently. -- I see Seoyeon's face without glasses for the first time.*

wall_seo_hug_choice.name: {name}
wall_seo_hug_choice.text: *Seoyeon is crying. I've never seen her like this.*

wall_seo_hug_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_hug_2.text: *Seoyeon buried her face in my chest. My school shirt is getting wet.*

wall_seo_hug_3.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_3.text: Mom said, 'At least you have to be perfect for this family to hold together.'

wall_seo_pinky_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_pinky_2.text: I promise. When you want to cry, you can cry in front of me.

wall_seo_pinky_4.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pinky_4.text: ...Why are you like this. Why do you — make promises so easily.

wall_seo_pinky_5.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pinky_5.text: Everyone says that and then disappears.

wall_seo_line_choice.name: {name}
wall_seo_line_choice.text: *Seoyeon is wiping her tears, looking up at me with trembling eyes.*
choices: I like this Seoyeon more than the perfect one.
You're not the student council president to me — you're just Seoyeon, my girlfriend.
Honestly, I thought you were flawless. But thank you for showing me this side of you.

wall_seo_after_line_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_2.text: This face — it's a mess right now, isn't it? Makeup smeared, eyes swollen. — Is this really okay?

wall_seo_after_line_4.name: {name}
wall_seo_after_line_4.text: *Seoyeon smiles. Her lips curve on their own. — Her makeup is smeared, her eyes are swollen. But I can't look away.*

wall_seo_after_line_5.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_5.text: For the first time in eight years, I think my unpracticed face might be okay.

wall_seo_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_1.text: *Walking home after seeing Seoyeon to her door. — I pass by the school.*

wall_seo_glimpse_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_2.text: *There's a light on in the gym window. Emergency lights. Someone is bouncing a ball alone. — I can faintly make out the jersey number. It's Dain.*

wall_seo_glimpse_3.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_3.text: *...Alone in the gym at 11 PM? She didn't contact me today.*

wall_seo_glimpse_4.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_4.text: *I paused for a moment — then kept walking. Tonight belongs to Seoyeon. But my feet feel heavy.*

wall_dain_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_2.text: Hey, you free right now? lol

wall_dain_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_3.text: Just come lol! I left the gym back door open!

wall_dain_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_4.text: *The dark gym, lit only by emergency lights. Dain is bouncing a volleyball alone. She's smiling harder than usual.*

wall_dain_6.name: {name}
wall_dain_6.text: Why are you at school at night?

wall_dain_7.name: Dain
wall_dain_7.text: I sneak in sometimes! To practice!!

wall_dain_9.name: {name}
wall_dain_9.text: *I toss the set. Dain leaps up — spikes it. The moment she lands — she grabs her right knee and crouches down.*

wall_dain_10.name: Dain
wall_dain_10.text: No, it's fine!! I just twisted it a bit lol, it's noth—

wall_dain_11.name: {name}
wall_dain_11.text: *Her hand gripping her knee has gone white. — It's not nothing.*

wall_dain_13.name: {name}
wall_dain_13.text: *I sit beside her without a word. Dain's mouth closes. A long silence.*

wall_dain_16.name: {name}
wall_dain_16.text: *Dain is making a face I've never seen before. Dain, not smiling.*

wall_dain_17.name: Dain
wall_dain_17.text: I had surgery, and the doctor — he was really careful about how he put it. 'Daily life will be fine, but playing like before...' — I don't remember what came after. Everything went silent.

wall_dain_18.name: Dain
wall_dain_18.text: Sports college. Pro league. National team. — Since I was five, that was all I had. And it ended in one sentence.

wall_dain_19.name: Dain
wall_dain_19.text: I didn't tell anyone. Not even my parents. 'Dain wouldn't be Dain if she couldn't play!' — I didn't want to hear that.

wall_dain_20.name: Dain
wall_dain_20.text: Every time someone at school said 'You're so full of energy!' — right here. ...I felt like dying.

wall_dain_21.name: Dain
wall_dain_21.text: Today too. Running around on our date. Pretending to be cheerful next to you. My knee was screaming.

wall_dain_22.name: Dain
wall_dain_22.text: — But if I show you I'm hurting too, then I have nothing left.

wall_dain_choice.name: {name}
wall_dain_choice.text: *Dain is clutching the volleyball, head down. Her shoulders are trembling.*
choices: You can cry. You don't have to pretend to be cheerful. Not with me.
...Shall we get up together? Just one more time.

wall_dain_newdream_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_1.text: *I sat down next to Dain. The court floor is cold. I didn't say anything.*

wall_dain_newdream_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_2.text: *Dain doesn't say anything either. — Strange moment. This is the first time silence has lasted more than a minute beside Dain.*

wall_dain_newdream_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_4.text: I'm waiting for when you want to talk.

wall_dain_newdream_5.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_5.text: *Dain looks at her hands resting on her knees. She clenches and unclenches her fists.*

wall_dain_newdream_6.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_6.text: Funny, right? I've stood on this court every day since I was five... and now I can't anymore.

wall_dain_newdream_7.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_7.text: But with you sitting next to me — the floor doesn't feel as cold.

wall_dain_newdream_8.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_8.text: *Not hitting a ball on the court, but sitting side by side with someone. — For Dain, even that was probably a first.*

wall_dain_cry_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_cry_1.text: *Dain collapsed onto the court. She started crying, hugging the volleyball.*

wall_dain_cry_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_cry_2.text: *As if a year's worth of held-back tears burst out at once. The sound of sobbing echoes through the empty gym.*

wall_dain_cry_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_3.text: All alone... wrapping my knee in bandages every morning...

wall_dain_cry_4.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_4.text: I put it in my phone alarm. 'Smile today!!' it says...

wall_dain_cry_5.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_5.text: Every morning I'd see that... see those two exclamation marks... and force my lips up...

wall_dain_cry_6.name: {name}
wall_dain_cry_6.text: *She put two exclamation marks in that alarm note — because one wasn't enough to fool even herself.*

wall_dain_lastspike_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_1.text: *I held out my hand. Dain took it. We both stood up. — I set the ball for her.*

wall_dain_lastspike_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_2.text: *Dain clenched her jaw and leapt — the perfect spike. The ball slams into the court.*

wall_dain_lastspike_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_3.text: *She grabbed her knee on landing — but she's smiling.*

wall_dain_lastspike_4.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_4.text: ...Heh. It hurts. But it feels oddly refreshing. — I'm glad my last hit on this court was a set from {name}.

wall_dain_lastspike_6.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_6.text: — Thirteen years since I was five. Thank you.

wall_dain_farewell_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_farewell_1.text: *A sentence from Dain with no exclamation marks at all. — That itself is the weight of farewell.*

wall_dain_farewell_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_farewell_2.text: *I leave the gym with Dain. We pass by the back gate of the school.*

wall_dain_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_1.text: *I see a light in the library annex window. A small desk lamp.*

wall_dain_glimpse_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_2.text: *It's Yuna. Sitting alone. Whether she's reading or just sitting there — I can't tell from here.*

wall_dain_glimpse_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_3.text: *Yuna didn't message me today. — Yuna never texts. Whether that's normal or just today — I don't know.*

wall_dain_glimpse_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_4.text: *I pretended not to see. — But why does my heart feel like this.*

wall_yuna_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_1.text: *10 PM. A message from Yuna. 'School back gate. Come now.'*

wall_yuna_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_2.text: *The school at night feels like a different place. Yuna is standing by the back gate. She looks more — uneasy than usual.*

wall_yuna_4.name: {name}
wall_yuna_4.text: *Yuna heads toward the library annex. Past her secret reading spot — deeper in. The basement archives.*

wall_yuna_5.name: {name}
wall_yuna_5.text: *Between dusty shelves. Yuna pulls out an old envelope.*

wall_yuna_6.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_6.text: This. I got it a year ago.

wall_yuna_7.name: {name}
wall_yuna_7.text: *A letter inside the envelope. — 'To Yuna. I'm sorry. I have to leave for reasons I can't explain. — Junho Lee'*

wall_yuna_9.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_9.text: A senior who used to come here with me. — The only person I was ever close to.

wall_yuna_10.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_10.text: In middle school, I was invisible. Nobody in class talked to me.

wall_yuna_11.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_11.text: He was the first. 'I liked your writing' — those words. To me, that was proof I existed.

wall_yuna_12.name: {name}
wall_yuna_12.text: *Yuna's sentences are far longer than usual. — This is the first time I've heard her speak this much.*

wall_yuna_13.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_13.text: One day he transferred. No contact. Just this letter.

wall_yuna_14.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14.text: The person who proved I existed — disappeared. I felt like I'd become invisible again.

wall_yuna_15.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_15.text: When you first came to the library. You had a similar vibe to him. — That's why I was scared. If I got close again, you might vanish too.

wall_yuna_16.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_16.text: But you came every day. Quietly. — Without disappearing.

wall_yuna_choice.name: {name}
wall_yuna_choice.text: *Yuna's eyes are glistening. — This is the first time I've heard her talk this much.*
choices: I'm not that senior. I'm me. But I'll still stay by your side.
Forget about that senior. The one standing in front of you right now is me.
...So you approached me because of him? As a replacement?

wall_yuna_moved_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_1.text: ...At first, maybe I was chasing his shadow.

wall_yuna_moved_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_moved_3.text: *Yuna lifts her head. Those aren't her usual half-closed red eyes. She's looking at me directly, unwavering.*

wall_yuna_moved_4.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_4.text: Now I see you. Only you.

wall_yuna_moved_5.name: {name}
wall_yuna_moved_5.text: *Yuna said four sentences in a row. — That's as good as a confession.*

wall_yuna_sub_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_sub_1.text: ...Don't get it twisted. You're not a stand-in. You're already more than enough as yourself.

wall_yuna_reject_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_reject_3.text: *Yuna turns away. Her steps are quick. — Not quite running, but the stride of someone who wants to.*

wall_yuna_reject_4.name: {name}
wall_yuna_reject_4.text: *That was the worst choice. — I can hear Yuna's wall closing shut again.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_1.text: *I leave the school, leaving Yuna behind. Passing the front gate.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_2.text: *Under the streetlight by the school gate. Seoyeon is standing there. — No, she was standing there. Holding her phone, typing something, then deleting it. Typing, then deleting.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3.text: *I don't know who she's trying to text. — Actually, I think I do.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_4.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_4.text:
*Seoyeon puts her phone in her pocket and turns around. Her back is straight. Perfectly. — Not trembling. For real this time.*

*Night comes even for those not chosen. She's spending that night alone.*

day4_night_regret.name: {name}
day4_night_regret.text: *...I could have said it today. Under that sunset, it was the perfect moment.*

day4_night_regret_2.name: {name}
day4_night_regret_2.text: *It's okay. There's tomorrow. Tomorrow, for sure.*

day4_night_regret_msg_seo.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_regret_msg_seo.text:
The breeze was nice today.
...Next time, I'm expecting different words.

day4_night_regret_msg_dain.name: Dain
day4_night_regret_msg_dain.text:
Hey, today was so fun lol
...But like, wasn't something missing?

day4_night_regret_msg.name: {name}
day4_night_regret_msg.text: *A message on my phone. I had fun today. Are you free tomorrow too?*

day4_night_regret_reply.name: {name}
day4_night_regret_reply.text: *Yeah, let's meet tomorrow too. Tomorrow, I'll definitely say it.*

day4_night_reflect.name: {name}
day4_night_reflect.text: *Saturday passed just like that. What will tomorrow bring.*

day4_night_sleep.name: {name}
day4_night_sleep.text: *I close my eyes. Tomorrow is the last day. — There are still things left to say.*

day4_final.name: {name}
day4_final.text: *Saturday night deepens. Tomorrow is Sunday — the last day.*

wall_seo_pre_high_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_high_2.text: *Seoyeon speaks first. Voluntarily. — This is a first.*

wall_seo_pre_low_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_low_1.text: *Seoyeon is silent. I need to be the one to reach out first.*

wall_seo_pre_low_1b.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_low_1b.text: *I sent a text. 'Seoyeon, are you okay?' — One minute. Read receipt appears. No reply. Then — my phone rings.*

wall_seo_pre_low_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pre_low_2.text: ...I saw your text. Can you come out now? The park. — Sorry, it's sudden.

wall_seo_mention_1.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_mention_1.text: ...Dain seems to be having a hard time lately. You know you're the reason, right?

wall_seo_mention_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_mention_2.text: I'm fine. I was chosen first. — But it still bothers me a little.

wall_seo_mention_3.name: {name}
wall_seo_mention_3.text: *Seoyeon looks into the distance for a moment. — Then looks back at me. Her eyes are steady.*

wall_seo_skin70_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_skin70_1.text: *Seoyeon extends her pinky first. She doesn't stop there. She takes my hand.*

wall_seo_skin70_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_skin70_2.text: *She presses her lips to my forehead.*

wall_seo_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_skin60_1.text: *On the Ferris wheel, Seoyeon leans on my shoulder.*

wall_dain_pre_high_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_pre_high_1.text: ...Can we talk about something other than sports today?

wall_dain_pre_high_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_pre_high_2.text: *Dain is unusually quiet. — A tone I've never heard before.*

wall_dain_mention_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_mention_1.text: You know what Seoyeon said to me? ...Nothing. She said nothing. That was scarier.

wall_dain_mention_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_mention_2.text: If she'd said something, at least I could've fought back. When someone says nothing, it makes you feel like the bad guy.

wall_dain_mention_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_mention_3.text: *Dain pauses briefly. — Then starts walking again. With lighter steps.*

wall_dain_skin70_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_skin70_1.text: *Dain cries and falls into my arms.*

wall_dain_skin70_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_skin70_3.text: *My shirt is getting wet. Dain's hands grip my back tightly. She won't loosen her grip.*

wall_dain_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_skin60_1.text: *After the sports center, we sit on a bench. Dain lays on my lap without warning.*

wall_yuna_pre_high_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_pre_high_2.text: *Yuna speaks directly instead of through notes. Her sentences are already long. — The wall is coming down.*

wall_yuna_pre_low_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_pre_low_2.text: *Still too early to say it in words.*

wall_yuna_mention_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_mention_1.text: ...Dain was crying. In the nurse's office.

wall_yuna_mention_2.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_mention_2.text: Because you chose me. ...I should be the one to apologize. But the words won't come out. That's what I hate more.

wall_yuna_mention_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_mention_3.text: *A brief silence. — Yuna's honesty is even heavier.*

wall_yuna_skin70_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin70_2.text: *She leans on my shoulder. She grips my hand tightly.*

wall_yuna_skin70_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin70_3.text: *Yuna's body temperature is low. But the hand she's holding is burning.*

wall_yuna_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin60_1.text: *Between the bookshelves of the used bookstore. Yuna presses her forehead against my back from behind.*

night_homeroom_msg_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_homeroom_msg_1.text: *Text message* The manuscript deadline is coming up. ...There's a part I want to show my first reader.

night_homeroom_msg_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_homeroom_msg_2.text: *Text message* Come to the faculty office tomorrow if you have time. — After class.

night_homeroom_msg_3.name: {name}
night_homeroom_msg_3.text: *11 PM. A text from Homeroom Teacher. Three short lines. — 'First reader.' Those words keep echoing in my head.*

night_nurse_msg_1.name: School Nurse
night_nurse_msg_1.text: What you said in my office today... I keep thinking about it at night.

night_nurse_msg_2.name: {name}
night_nurse_msg_2.text: *A message from the school nurse came through. 11 PM. Just one sentence.*

wall_seo_to_park.name: {name}
wall_seo_to_park.text: *I left the house and headed to the park.*

wall_seo_9_ins.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_9_ins.text: My family looks fine on the outside, right? Big house, nice car, student council president's daughter.

wall_seo_9_ins2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_9_ins2.text: But Mom and Dad have been strangers under the same roof for a year. They just haven't filed the papers.

wall_seo_11_ins.name: {name}
wall_seo_11_ins.text: *Seoyeon presses her lips shut. As if swallowing something.*

wall_seo_14_ins2.name: {name}
wall_seo_14_ins2.text: *Seoyeon stops talking. Her hands are clenched on her knees.*

wall_seo_14_ins3.name: {name}
wall_seo_14_ins3.text: *And slowly, very slowly, the perfectly maintained expression crumbles. With trembling hands, Seoyeon takes off her glasses.*

wall_seo_14_ins4.name: {name}
wall_seo_14_ins4.text: *Tears run down silently. Without a sound. I'm seeing Seoyeon's face without glasses for the first time.*

wall_seo_hug_2_ins.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_2_ins.text: ...Crying in front of someone, it's the first time since elementary school.

wall_seo_hug_2_ins2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_2_ins2.text: Eight years. All that time, I only ever cried alone in the bathroom.

wall_seo_pinky_5_ins.name: {name}
wall_seo_pinky_5_ins.text: *The pinky from Day 1. The pinky from Day 4. Same finger, completely different weight.*

wall_seo_after_line_4_ins.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_4_ins.text: ...I don't think I need a mirror today.

wall_seo_glimpse_1_ins.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_1_ins.text: *There's a light in the gym window. Emergency lighting.*

wall_dain_8_ins.name: {name}
wall_dain_8_ins.text: *I toss the ball up. Dain jumps and — spikes it.*

wall_dain_8_ins2.name: {name}
wall_dain_8_ins2.text: *The moment she lands — she grabs her right knee and crouches down.*

wall_dain_16_ins.name: Dain
wall_dain_16_ins.text: I had surgery and the medical team — they chose their words really carefully.

wall_dain_18_ins.name: Dain
wall_dain_18_ins.text: But it all ended in one sentence.

wall_dain_18_ins3.name: Dain
wall_dain_18_ins3.text: I didn't tell anyone. Not even my parents.

wall_dain_22_ins.name: {name}
wall_dain_22_ins.text: *I sat down next to Dain. The court floor is cold. I said nothing.*

wall_dain_lastspike_4_ins.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_4_ins.text: *Dain looks around the court. The dark, empty gym.*

wall_yuna_14_ins.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_ins.text: For a year I came here alone. Hoping he'd left something behind.

wall_yuna_14_ins4.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_ins4.text: When you first came to the library.

wall_yuna_14_ins5.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_ins5.text: You had the same vibe as him. That's why I was scared.

wall_yuna_14_ins6.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_ins6.text: If I got close again, you might disappear too.

wall_yuna_16_ins.name: {name}
wall_yuna_16_ins.text: *Yuna grips her sleeve tightly. Her sentences are getting longer.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins.text: *Seoyeon puts her phone in her pocket and turns around. Her back is straight. Perfectly. She's not trembling. Not this time.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins2.text: *Night comes even for the ones not chosen. And they spend that night alone.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins3.text: *11 PM. Phone buzzes. The Homeroom Teacher.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins4.name: Homeroom Teacher
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins4.text: *Message* The manuscript deadline is coming up.

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins5.name: Homeroom Teacher
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins5.text: *Message* ...There's a part I want to show my first reader.

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins6.name: Homeroom Teacher
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins6.text: *Message* Come to the staff room tomorrow if you're free. After school.

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins8.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins8.text: *Her sentences are always short. No filler. But this one felt different. There's a part I want to show. That one line carries weight.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins9.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins9.text: *First reader. That phrase keeps echoing in my head. The person a writer most wants to show their work to. Does that mean me, or is it just because I happen to be nearby.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins10.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins10.text: *...I don't know. But I feel like I should go tomorrow.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins11.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins11.text: *11:30 PM. Phone notification. The School Nurse.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins12.name: School Nurse
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins12.text: *Message* What you said in the nurse's office today.

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins14.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins14.text: *Read receipt appears. 10 seconds. 20 seconds. No follow-up.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins16.name: School Nurse
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins16.text: *Message* Oh, not in a weird way. I just meant it was memorable.

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins18.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins18.text: *Today there's a school event. The last one. The moment I step into class — signals come from three directions.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins19.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins19.text: *I keep thinking about it tonight. Reading that, my fingers froze. Only after the not in a weird way came through could I breathe again.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins20.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins20.text: *But the strange part is — the correction took a whole minute. What was she agonizing over for one minute? Did she regret it after sending, or did she already regret it before.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins21.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins21.text: *There's a note on my desk. Seoyeon's handwriting. Make some time this afternoon. I'll leave the rooftop unlocked. — Seoyeon*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins22.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins22.text: *...I try to remember what I said. It was nothing special. But maybe it wasn't nothing to her.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins23.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_ins23.text: *Walking past the literary club's display in the hallway — a short story is pinned to the board. Title: To the Person I Met at the Library. It's Yuna. A story only its subject would recognize.*
